listings.name: Dr Sven Strydom
listings.current_description: Dr Sven Strydom is a specialist orthopaedic surgeon practicing at Life Eugene Marais Hospital in Pretoria, treating disorders of the musculoskeletal system including adult and paediatric trauma, hip and knee replacements, and joint arthroscopy, with a focus on hand surgery using the WALANT (wide-awake local anaesthesia) technique.

listings.name: DSV Accounting
listings.current_description: DSV Accounting is a professional accounting firm in Doringkloof, Centurion, offering financial statement preparation, bookkeeping, tax advisory and returns filing, and estate and trust planning, serving businesses of all sizes and individuals with a team drawing on over 25 years of combined financial and customer service experience.

listings.name: E & I Metal Pressing cc
listings.current_description: E & I Metal Pressing cc is a Booysens-based metal engineering company, founded in 1995, offering metal pressing and forming, welding of non-ferrous metals such as aluminium and stainless steel, pipe bending (press, rotary draw and roll bending), precision metal cutting, and aluminium product installation and maintenance.

listings.name: EEC
listings.current_description: EEC (Effectual Energy Consultants) is a Lyttelton Manor-based engineering firm specialising in renewable energy, power security and business continuity, offering bespoke residential solar and backup systems with European components and customised commercial power systems, with clients including Security Warehouse, Centurion Golf Estate, Southern Implants and Carbon International.

listings.name: Elephant Lifting Equipment
listings.current_description: Elephant Lifting Equipment is a Southern African supplier, designer and manufacturer of industrial lifting equipment, established in 1982. Based in Rooihuiskraal, Centurion, they supply electric and manual chain hoists, wire rope hoists, slings, rigging accessories and jib cranes, and offer service, repair, proof load testing and certification.

listings.name: Elite Clearing and Forwarding (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Elite Clearing and Forwarding (Pty) Ltd is a SARS AEO-accredited freight forwarding and customs clearance company established in 2006, handling air and sea cargo imports and exports - including firearms & ammunition, electronics, mining machinery and motor vehicles - with offices in Gauteng, Cape Town and Durban.

listings.name: KOST Quotation Software
listings.current_description: KOST Quotation Software develops a quotation and invoicing application used by service businesses to manage jobs and get paid faster. The software lets users create quotes from templates with preloaded material pricing, send quotes and invoices via WhatsApp, and integrates with accounting platforms like Sage and QuickBooks.

listings.name: Kristal Auctions
listings.current_description: Kristal Auctions is one of the largest auction houses in Gauteng, selling movable assets ranging from household and storage contents to farming, construction and business equipment, holding weekly auctions at its Andeon venue as well as onsite sales nationwide and training newcomers through its in-house auction academy.

listings.name: LM in the East
listings.current_description: LM in the East is one of Pretoria's oldest Portuguese family restaurants, known for its seafood, pizza and steak menu including prawns, calamari and prego rolls. It is located in Lynnwood Galleries on the corner of Rosemary and Diana Streets, and trades daily from 10am to 10pm.

listings.name: Marebole Security Solutions
listings.current_description: Marebole Security Solutions is a 100% Black-owned security services company based in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, incorporated in 2009 and registered with PSIRA. It offers armed guards, CCTV surveillance, alarm systems, access control, armed response and gate automation, and is certified as a National Key Point service provider.

listings.name: Mbozisi Construction & Architect
listings.current_description: Mbozisi Construction & Architect provides end-to-end building and design services, from residential and commercial construction and renovations to architectural design and municipal plan submissions, geotechnical soil testing and foundation design, civil site work, plant hire and building material supply, serving Pretoria, Centurion, Midrand, Johannesburg and surrounding areas.

listings.name: MC van der Berg Attorneys Inc
listings.current_description: MC van der Berg Attorneys Inc is a property law firm specializing in conveyancing, bond registration, property transfers, wills and testaments, deceased estate administration, and sectional title registration, having grown from a small practice founded in Sunnyside in 1999 into offices across Centurion, Pretoria East and Midstream.

listings.name: Med-Step Clinic
listings.current_description: Med-Step Clinic is a sub-acute rehabilitation clinic in Eloffsdal, founded in 2005, offering 24 single rooms and 3 double rooms fitted with DSTV, air conditioning, wall oxygen and suction, and providing neurological, orthopaedic, cardiovascular, respiratory, restorative and palliative rehabilitation care for patients transitioning from hospital to home.

listings.name: Melanie Peyper
listings.current_description: This Centurion practice was established in 2010 as Irene Village Mall Optometrists before adopting its current name five years later, offering eye tests, frames and contact lenses with equipment including a fundus camera and topographer, and specialised fittings for scleral lenses, keratoconus, multifocal correction and sports vision.

listings.name: Mentornet
listings.current_description: Mentornet is a private college accredited by the ETDP SETA that has specialised in education, training and development for over 35 years, notably becoming the first private college accredited for a full qualification in this field, and now offers more than 100 short courses alongside occupational qualifications.

listings.name: MLS Gauteng North
listings.current_description: MLS Gauteng North is a non-profit multiple listing service bringing together more than 50 real estate agencies across Pretoria North, who share their property stock as a team rather than competing separately. Its service area includes Dorandia along with surrounding suburbs such as Montana, Annlin and Akasia.

listings.name: Moore Pretoria
listings.current_description: Moore Pretoria, established in 1984 and based in Lynnwood, Pretoria, is an accounting, audit and tax consulting firm with around 50 staff serving clients across Pretoria and Johannesburg, and is the local member of the Moore Global network of more than 30,000 staff in 112 countries.

listings.name: MRJ Consultants | Genesis Retail Software
listings.current_description: MRJ Consultants, trading as Genesis Retail Software, is a Centurion-based software developer founded in 1996 that builds and supports the Genesis point-of-sale and ERP system for the retail sector, covering everything from stock control through to general ledger, alongside managed IT services delivered through its Nexus platform.

listings.name: OLYMPIC CATERING EQUIPMENT
listings.current_description: Olympic Catering Equipment has been manufacturing and supplying catering and refrigeration equipment since 1971, and its Pretoria West premises include a stainless steel fabrication facility, a refrigeration manufacturing plant, a repairs department, and both new and secondhand equipment showrooms, plus free kitchen design consultations for hospitality clients.

listings.name: Plug & Play Solutions
listings.current_description: Plug & Play Solutions is a security and surveillance company based in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, offering CCTV installation, integrated access control, remote monitoring and AI-driven surveillance systems. Its custom-built security infrastructure, including biometric access systems, serves clients in sectors such as retail, finance, mining, aviation and government.

listings.name: Qbis Software
listings.current_description: Qbis Software is a software development company in The Willows, founded in 2000, that builds business management systems spanning CRM, ERP and business intelligence reporting. It offers integrated tools for projects, billing, sales & marketing, reporting and collaboration, with a flexible design that adapts to different industries.

listings.name: QEDO Pretoria
listings.current_description: QEDO Pretoria operates from Centurion as an Acumatica cloud ERP partner, delivering industry software solutions that combine financial management with integrated CRM, distribution, manufacturing, field service and project accounting modules, and was acquired by IT services and advisory firm APPSolve in 2024 to strengthen its Acumatica offering.

listings.name: Register Your Business (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Register Your Business handles company and tax registrations with CIPC, SARS and the Department of Labour, including Pty Ltd, Inc, NPC and co-operative registration, VAT, PAYE and UIF registration, and secretarial services such as annual returns, typically completing a company registration within five to seven working days.

listings.name: Reliance Laboratory Equipment
listings.current_description: Reliance Laboratory Equipment supplies testing equipment for the construction and civil engineering sectors, covering soil, asphalt and bitumen, concrete, coring and sampling, and particle-size analysis, manufactured to SANS specifications with SANAS calibration services; the family-owned business was established in 1947 and is now in its third generation.

listings.name: SA Fire Holdings - (SA Fire Group) - Wonderboom South
listings.current_description: SA Fire Holdings (SA Fire Group) supplies and services certified fire equipment such as extinguishers, hose reels and hydrants to SANS 1475 standards, along with smoke and heat detection systems, field firefighting equipment, and fire safety and first-aid training, from its premises on Steve Biko Road, Wonderboom.

listings.name: SIGMA LOGISTIC SOLUTIONS
listings.current_description: SIGMA LOGISTIC SOLUTIONS is a logistics support business in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, specialising in technical documentation, S1000D-compliant technical authoring and illustrating, maintenance engineering and logistic support analysis, and its proprietary SIGMA-IDVS interactive maintenance management system, with over 30 years of experience in the defence and commercial sectors.

listings.name: The Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
listings.current_description: This office operates as a Built Environment Capacity Building partnership between the Association of Construction Project Managers and the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure, delivering training and professional development to build technical capacity in the built environment professions, based in the Menlyn Maine Precinct, Waterkloof Glen.

listings.name: Venter Consulting Engineers
listings.current_description: Venter Consulting Engineers is a precision-engineering firm in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, working across turbo machinery, gear technology, general heavy-industrial engineering and precision CNC manufacturing, with services including structural and vibration analysis, computational fluid dynamics and 3D dimensional inspection for the power generation, mining, aerospace and petrochemical industries.

listings.name: WALLI 5 Star Enterprises (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: WALLI 5 Star Enterprises is a diversified multi-service company based in Erasmia, Centurion, supplying IT and ICT solutions, interactive audio-visual systems, e-learning platforms, furniture, solar, gas and water systems, stationery and travel services including Hajj and Umrah packages, with additional offices in Cape Town, Durban and Polokwane.

listings.name: Workshop@LPM Trading
listings.current_description: Workshop@LPM Trading is a car service and repair workshop in Raslouw, Centurion, servicing all vehicle makes and models with air-conditioning work, auto electrical repairs, battery sales, clutch work, computerised diagnostics, wheel alignment and balancing, diesel particulate filter service and tow-bar fitment, plus 24/7 emergency call-outs.

listings.name: Aandklas
listings.current_description: Aandklas is a rock-and-roll pub, restaurant and live-music venue on Hilda Street in Hatfield that has operated since 2006 in a building that was previously the student hangout Up The Creek, known for weekly events like Rock Thursdays, table-dancing Fridays, live bands on Saturdays and Sunday open-mic nights.

listings.name: Ascor Independent Wealth Managers
listings.current_description: Ascor Independent Wealth Managers is a fee-based wealth management firm founded in 1998, based at Persequor Techno Park, Pretoria, offering financial, estate and investment planning as well as tax, auditing and accounting services, twice named Best Advisor Practice for South Africa by International Advisor magazine (2016 and 2018).

listings.name: Astore Keymak Pretoria
listings.current_description: Astore Keymak is a supplier of thermoplastic pipe fittings, valves, pipeline accessories and plastic welding equipment, with its Pretoria branch in Waltloo; the company was built from the heritage of Astore Africa (plastic pipe and fittings) and Keymak (flexible hose manufacturing) and operates 10 branches across South Africa.

listings.name: Astron Energy Pretoria North
listings.current_description: Astron Energy Pretoria North is a fuel station on Rachel de Beer Street, Pretoria North, part of the Astron Energy network -- the brand that has been rebranding South Africa's former Caltex service stations since 2021, after Astron Energy took over the Caltex licence from Chevron in 2018.

listings.name: AVBOB
listings.current_description: AVBOB is Africa's largest Mutual Assurance Society, providing funeral insurance and funeral services since 1918 through a national network of more than 188 funeral agencies and 132 insurance offices; as a mutual society, it has no external shareholders and returns profits to its members as benefits and bonuses.

listings.name: Aveng Trident Steel
listings.current_description: Aveng Trident Steel's Rosslyn branch is an automotive distribution and steel merchanting facility supplying original equipment and component manufacturers in the automotive just-in-time steel supply chain, processing and warehousing more than a million tons of steel a year including automotive blanks, special steel, structural plate, pipe and tube.

listings.name: Bakali Foodstuffs Pty Ltd
listings.current_description: Bakali Foodstuffs Pty Ltd, based in Samrand Business Park, Centurion, makes healthy rice and corn cake snacks -- gluten-free and low in fat and sugar -- with roots dating back to a sugar-waffle business started in the DRC in 1975 before expanding into South Africa in the 1990s.

listings.name: Battiss Guest House
listings.current_description: Battiss Guest House occupies a house on 20th Street in Menlo Park originally designed in 1939 by architect Norman Eaton for South African artist Walter Battiss, rescued from demolition and renovated in the 1980s and again in 2020, now operating as a highly rated Pretoria bed and breakfast.

listings.name: Bramland Group Tree Felling / Boomsloping / Tree Care / Stump Grinding & Removal in Pretoria
listings.current_description: Bramland Group provides tree felling, stump grinding, and tree care services across Pretoria and Gauteng, including pruning, site clearing, big tree transplanting, and wood chipping, and also sells firewood, charcoal, and compost made from processed trees. The company says it has operated since 1992 and offers 24-hour call-outs.

listings.name: Brother International South Africa
listings.current_description: Brother International South Africa is the local arm of the Brother technology brand, manufacturing and selling printers, sewing and embroidery machines, label printers, and cutting and crafting machines for business and personal use. It also provides supplies, accessories, and business solutions such as fleet management and mobile printing.

listings.name: Cafe Beyritz
listings.current_description: Cafe Beyritz, owned and managed by Etienne and Emi Maritz, is a European bistro with a French slant at Lynnwood Bridge, offering separate breakfast, lunch and fine-dining dinner menus - from eggs Benedict and croque monsieur to roasted lamb and slow-roasted duck - alongside an extensive wine list.

listings.name: CCS Logistics
listings.current_description: CCS Logistics, based in Louwlardia, Centurion, is part of the CCH group, described on its website as one of Africa's largest cold storage and logistics operators. Services include cold storage, blast freezing, bonded warehousing, palletisation, and container staging, with facilities listed in Cape Town, Johannesburg/Midrand, and Namibia.

listings.name: CXO| Dynamic Business Solutions Pty (Ltd)
listings.current_description: CXO Dynamic Business Solutions is a South African ICT consulting firm established in 2008 that provides enterprise software (including performance, product lifecycle, content, risk and quality management systems), skilled IT staff and consultants, network/IT infrastructure, and professional training through its CXO Academy, from its Irene, Centurion office.

listings.name: Dynamic Auctioneers
listings.current_description: Dynamic Auctioneers is the auction division of Dynamic Solutions 1068 (Pty) Ltd, established in 2002 and based in Raslouw, Centurion, running auctions of vehicles, machinery, electronics, and commercial, industrial, agricultural and vacant-land property, and accredited with the SA Institute of Auctioneers, EAAB, PPRA and the National Auction Association.

listings.name: Eaglebyte
listings.current_description: Eaglebyte is a managed IT services provider established in 2011 and based in Villieria, Pretoria, offering IT support, business email, cloud file storage, endpoint security, and domain and web hosting, as well as security systems including Hikvision surveillance, access control and alarms. The company is a Microsoft Partner.

listings.name: ECIC
listings.current_description: ECIC is the Export Credit Insurance Corporation of South Africa SOC Ltd, a state-owned national export credit agency established in 2001 that provides political and commercial risk insurance to South African exporters of capital goods and related services, with a particular focus on Africa and other emerging markets.

listings.name: Ecoscape Landscape Construction Pretoria East
listings.current_description: Ecoscape Landscape Construction is a landscaping and construction company serving Pretoria East and the wider Gauteng area, offering garden design, paving, retaining walls, outdoor entertainment areas and full construction projects. The company says it has over 24 years of experience and has completed more than 700 garden projects.

listings.name: Ergo Designer Kitchens & Cabinetry
listings.current_description: Ergo Designer Kitchens & Cabinetry is a Pretoria-based, women-owned studio that designs, manufactures and installs kitchens, built-in cupboards, vanities and home offices from its own factory in Koedoespoort. With more than a decade in the cabinetry industry, the company has won design awards at the Homemakers Expo Pretoria.

listings.name: EZAIR Airconditioning (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: EZAIR Air Conditioning (Pty) Ltd sells, installs, services and repairs air conditioners and heat pumps for residential and commercial customers, working with brands including Samsung, Midea, LG, Daikin and Alliance. The company operates from Pretoria and Ballito and holds a 4.5-star Google rating from around 50 reviews.

listings.name: Gamazine Paint
listings.current_description: Gamazine Paint manufactures and applies Gamazine decorative plaster-finish paint -- a custom-mixed blend of crushed marble, sand and quartz stone chips -- from its premises in East Lynne, delivering and applying the product across South Africa with a finish that can last up to 20 years without repainting.
